gaps.explanation: Two parts. (1) missing fund column, 471,728: p2 Exhibit B 'Other Governmental Funds' column disbursements Culture and Recreation 98,672 + General government 18,503 + Public Safety 15,750 + Public Works 206,514 + Public Health and Welfare 132,289 = Total disbursements 471,728 (printed); not in detail[] (no nonmajor schedule in the trim). These lines are correct and complete for that column. (2) 5,025 that cannot be fixed with printed lines: General Fund Schedule 3 (p4) does not foot as printed - Clerk lines 115,196 + 12,356 + 1,461 = 129,013 vs printed Total Clerk 129,072 (+59); Elections lines 615 + 1,238 = 1,853 vs printed Total Elections 6,819 (+4,966). detail[] holds every printed object line (765,836) while the printed Total Cash Disbursements is 770,861 (= Exhibit B General Fund). No printed line carries the 5,025, and department totals are subtotals that may not be added. Check: 1,305,812 + 471,728 = 1,777,540; statement 1,782,565; residual 5,025 = the Schedule 3 footing difference. Operating transfers of the Other Governmental Funds column (in 59,000, out (748), p2) are not added because the report has no transfers gap row (Total column eliminates them).
